headline: Tesla starts Optimus production while quarterly profit falls
summary: Tesla began early production of its Optimus humanoid robot in Fremont, California, as announced on its Q3 earnings call, even as quarterly profit fell 43% on flat revenue and rising expenses. Musk said the robot's hands, safety, reliability, durability and AI still need work.

claims.statement: Tesla began production of its Optimus humanoid robot.

sources.quote: Tesla starts Optimus robot production in California
the company had begun early production of its humanoid robot on its high-volume line in Fremont, California

claims.statement: Tesla's revenue was flat while its expenses rose sharply.

sources.quote: Tesla's revenue was flat and its expenses skyrocketed

claims.statement: Musk said parts of Optimus still need work, including its hands, safety, reliability, durability and AI.

sources.quote: the robot's hands, its safety, reliability, and durability, and the artificial intelligence needed to make it a productive tool

discrepancies.explanation: TechCrunch frames Optimus's production start against a 43% profit drop, while The Verge frames the same milestone as not yet ready given unresolved hardware and safety work.

quotes.quote: Just because Tesla’s Optimus is in production doesn’t mean it’s actually ready
